name: native-live-assistant-feedback
description: 通过真实 Assistant 行 hover 按钮验证点赞、同一行点踩、取消反应和冷恢复；不注入 renderer 状态、不直接调用 IPC。Journal 断言三条 assistant_feedback_set 事实，Source row fixture 负责确认取消态省略 feedback。
offlineContracts: apps/ui/test/frontendContracts.test.ts: assistant_feedback_rows.json 通过 Source conversationRowSchema；like/dislike 为枚举，取消态省略 feedback，feedback:null 被拒绝。
core/runtime::tests::assistant_feedback_persists_cancels_and_rejects_stale_cas: Journal、重复 operationId、冷恢复和 stale CAS。

steps.expression: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="task-item-"]')).at(-1); if (!row) throw new Error('未找到反馈验收任务行'); window.__nativeFeedbackTaskTestId = row.getAttribute('data-testid'); return true; })()
steps.description: 固定真实 feedback 会话的持久任务行

steps.expression: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-row-id]')).find(e => e.classList.contains('group/assistant-row') && e.innerText.includes('NATIVE_FEEDBACK_READY_42')); const rowId = row?.getAttribute('data-row-id'); const turn = row?.closest('[data-turn-id]'); const like = rowId ? document.querySelector('[data-testid="v4-feedback-like-' + rowId + '"]') : null; if (!rowId || !turn || !like || like.closest('[data-turn-id]') !== turn) throw new Error('未找到与 Assistant row 同一 turn 的 feedback action'); window.__nativeFeedbackRowId = rowId; window.__nativeFeedbackTurnId = turn.getAttribute('data-turn-id'); turn.setAttribute('data-native-feedback-target', 'true'); return true; })()
steps.description: 固定真实 Assistant 行 rowId，并标记其 turn 容器

steps.expression: (() => { const id = window.__nativeFeedbackRowId; const target = document.querySelector('[data-native-feedback-target="true"]'); const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-row-id]')).find(e => e.classList.contains('group/assistant-row') && e.getAttribute('data-row-id') === id && e.innerText.includes('NATIVE_FEEDBACK_READY_42')); const button = target?.querySelector('[data-testid="v4-feedback-like-' + id + '"]'); return !!row && !!target && !!button && target.contains(button) && button.closest('[data-turn-id]') === target; })()

steps.expression: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-row-id]')).find(e => e.classList.contains('group/assistant-row') && e.innerText.includes('NATIVE_FEEDBACK_READY_42')); const rowId = row?.getAttribute('data-row-id'); const turn = row?.closest('[data-turn-id]'); const like = rowId ? document.querySelector('[data-testid="v4-feedback-like-' + rowId + '"]') : null; if (!rowId || !turn || !like || like.closest('[data-turn-id]') !== turn) throw new Error('点赞冷恢复后未找到与 Assistant row 同一 turn 的 feedback action'); window.__nativeFeedbackRowId = rowId; window.__nativeFeedbackTurnId = turn.getAttribute('data-turn-id'); turn.setAttribute('data-native-feedback-target', 'true'); return true; })()
(() => { const id = window.__nativeFeedbackRowId; const button = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="v4-feedback-like-${id}"]`); return button?.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true'; })()
steps.description: Journal 重建后同一 row 仍显示点赞

steps.expression: (() => { const id = window.__nativeFeedbackRowId; const like = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="v4-feedback-like-${id}"]`); const dislike = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="v4-feedback-dislike-${id}"]`); return like?.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'false' && dislike?.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true'; })()
steps.description: 同一 Assistant 行确认点踩替换点赞

steps.expression: (() => { const id = window.__nativeFeedbackRowId; const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-row-id]')).find(e => e.classList.contains('group/assistant-row') && e.getAttribute('data-row-id') === id); const turn = row?.closest('[data-turn-id]'); const dislike = id ? document.querySelector('[data-testid="v4-feedback-dislike-' + id + '"]') : null; if (!row || !turn || !dislike || dislike.closest('[data-turn-id]') !== turn) throw new Error('点踩投影后 Assistant row 与 feedback action 未保持同一 turn'); turn.setAttribute('data-native-feedback-target', 'true'); return true; })()
